name: Monday.com
verdict: Self-serve: promote a version to live, accept the developer terms and share the auth link, with no review. Customers see an unvetted-app banner, and the optional marketplace listing is reviewed; personal-token apps are not eligible.
needGuide: Short one: build the app, set scopes, share the link; skip the marketplace unless you want it.

auth.detail: Authorization code at auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize. Legacy flow: non-expiring access tokens, no refresh tokens. New OAuth 2.1 flow (per app version toggle): PKCE S256 required, expiring JWT access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, token endpoint auth.monday.com/oauth_ms/oauth/token, revoke and RFC 8414 discovery endpoints. Authorization codes are valid 10 minutes.

effort.timeToProduction: 1-3 days via share link; marketplace several weeks (likely)

approval.gate: No review needed to share a public app by link: after promoting a version to live, accept the developer terms on the Share tab and copy the auth.monday.com link (can restrict to specific accounts). Unreviewed apps show a banner saying monday has not vetted them. Marketplace listing is optional but needs review (initial response within 72 business hours); apps using the personal API token, or built mainly with no-code/AI-generated code, are not eligible.

scopes.why: Read and write scopes across many areas; requested scopes must match the app's configured scopes.
scopes.summary: Scopes cover account, boards, docs, updates, users, teams, workspaces, webhooks, tags, notifications and profile, mostly with read and write variants; the requested scope must match the app's configured scopes. Full list at the discovery endpoint. Scope-specific review not documented; marketplace review covers security and privacy generally.

cost: Free to build; free developer accounts offered; marketplace listing terms (e.g. revenue share) not confirmed
prerequisites: Account and owner: A monday user who can open the Developer Center; use a company account on a dedicated developer account. Exact role needed not documented.
Where you register: monday avatar → Developers (Developer Center) → Create app → OAuth & Permissions tab (scopes, redirect URLs, 'New OAuth Flow' toggle) → App versions → promote to live → Share tab
Cost: Free to build; free developer accounts offered; marketplace listing terms (e.g. revenue share) not confirmed

registerAt.path: monday avatar → Developers (Developer Center) → Create app → OAuth & Permissions tab (scopes, redirect URLs, 'New OAuth Flow' toggle) → App versions → promote to live → Share tab

steps.do: Create a monday developer account and open Developers → Create app
On OAuth & Permissions set redirect URLs and minimum scopes (e.g. me:read, boards:read, boards:write); enable the New OAuth Flow toggle on the draft
Implement authorize with PKCE S256, token exchange at the oauth_ms endpoint, proactive refresh (under 5 minutes left) and refresh-token rotation
Test with the draft 'Active for me' and app_version_id, then promote the version to live
Install on your account (Install tab), then on the Share tab accept developer terms and copy the share link or restrict to specific accounts
Have an admin of a separate monday account install via the link and run an end-to-end test
Optionally submit to the marketplace using the listing guidelines and review checklist

roles.team: A monday user who can open the Developer Center; use a company account on a dedicated developer account. Exact role needed not documented.
roles.console: App collaborators exist (they can run the OAuth flow on draft versions via app_version_id); exact add-collaborator UI path not confirmed.
roles.customer: An account admin typically installs (force_install_if_needed returns users after an admin installs). Recipients find shared apps under Apps → Installed Apps → 'Installed outside the marketplace'. Admin install restrictions not documented.

testing: Install on your own account via Developer Center → Install tab; keep the draft version 'Active for me' to test the new OAuth flow before promoting.
Free developer accounts are available for fuller testing.
Private apps are limited to one account; public apps can be shared.

blockers.problem: Legacy tokens never expire but have no refresh; the new flow expires tokens
blockers.fix: Migrate and store rotating refresh tokens (migration endpoint is temporary).

blockers.problem: Personal API token auth blocks marketplace approval
Unvetted-app banner appears for non-marketplace installs
blockers.fix: Warn customers or pursue marketplace review.

blockers.problem: Vibe-coded or no-code-built apps are ineligible for the marketplace

automation.agentCan: Write PKCE and refresh code, draft listing copy and review-checklist answers, run test GraphQL calls, and prepare admin install guidance.
automation.humanMust: Developer Center sign-in, accepting developer and listing terms, marketplace submission form and board follow-ups, and customer admin installation.

uncertain: Whether an OAuth-only app needs a feature or view to be valid, admin controls restricting installs, collaborator UI path, the legacy flow deprecation date, and marketplace fees were not confirmed; several doc pages failed to fetch.
